en: Hi! I'm Tanto's portfolio assistant. Ask me about his experience, projects, skills or web services.
id: Halo! Saya asisten portofolio Tanto. Silakan tanya soal pengalaman, project, skill, atau layanan web-nya.

en: You're welcome! Anything else you'd like to know?
id: Sama-sama! Ada lagi yang ingin ditanyakan?
Senang bisa membantu. Ada yang lain?

en: Thanks for stopping by! If you'd like to work together, Tanto is one email away: {email}
id: Terima kasih sudah mampir! Kalau ingin kerja sama, Tanto bisa langsung dihubungi di {email}

en: I'm a simple automated assistant that runs entirely in your browser. I answer from the content on this site and don't send your messages anywhere. For anything I can't answer, you can email Tanto directly.
id: Saya asisten otomatis sederhana yang berjalan langsung di browser Anda. Jawaban saya diambil dari isi website ini, dan pesan Anda tidak dikirim ke mana pun. Untuk hal yang tidak bisa saya jawab, silakan email Tanto langsung.

en: Tanto Wibowo (Ir., S.Kom., M.Kom., IPP.) is a full-stack software engineer and UI/UX designer based in Makassar, Indonesia. Since 2019 he has shipped enterprise web platforms for clients in Singapore, France and Hong Kong — Grails back ends, Next.js front ends and CMS interfaces he designs himself. He holds a master's in Computer Science (machine learning) and is a certified professional engineer.
id: Tanto Wibowo (Ir., S.Kom., M.Kom., IPP.) adalah full-stack software engineer sekaligus UI/UX designer yang berbasis di Makassar, Indonesia. Sejak 2019 ia membangun platform web enterprise untuk klien di Singapura, Prancis, dan Hong Kong — mulai dari back end Grails, front end Next.js, sampai antarmuka CMS yang ia desain sendiri. Ia bergelar magister Ilmu Komputer (machine learning) dan insinyur profesional bersertifikat.

en: Tanto's enterprise work (through Fairtech Pte. Ltd.) is for global brands in Singapore, France and Hong Kong — a restaurant & hotel review platform, a camera brand's corporate site, a national digital health platform and more. Client names are kept confidential under NDA, so I can share the kind of work and the stack, but not the brands.
id: Pekerjaan enterprise Tanto (melalui Fairtech Pte. Ltd.) untuk brand global di Singapura, Prancis, dan Hong Kong — platform review restoran & hotel, website korporat brand kamera, platform kesehatan digital nasional, dan lainnya. Nama klien dirahasiakan karena NDA, jadi saya bisa menjelaskan jenis pekerjaan dan stack-nya, tapi tidak nama brand-nya.

en: Every project is quoted individually — the price depends on scope, number of pages or features, integrations and timeline, so there isn't a one-size-fits-all rate. Share a few details and Tanto will reply with an estimate, usually within a day.
id: Setiap project dihitung terpisah — harga tergantung cakupan, jumlah halaman atau fitur, integrasi, dan timeline, jadi tidak ada tarif yang sama untuk semua. Ceritakan sedikit kebutuhan Anda dan Tanto akan membalas dengan estimasi, biasanya dalam satu hari.

en: Timelines depend on scope — a focused landing page is much quicker than a full web app with an admin panel. You'll get a timeline together with the quote, broken down into design, build and review stages.
id: Waktu pengerjaan tergantung cakupan — landing page sederhana jauh lebih cepat dibanding web app lengkap dengan panel admin. Timeline akan diberikan bersama penawaran, dibagi per tahap desain, pengembangan, dan review.

en:
A typical project goes like this:
• Discovery — a short chat about your goals, users and must-have features
• Proposal — scope, timeline and quote
• Design — wireframes and UI in Figma, with your feedback
• Build — development with regular previews on a staging link
• Review & launch — revisions, testing on real devices, then go-live
• Support — handover, documentation and optional maintenance
id:
Alur project biasanya seperti ini:
• Diskusi — ngobrol singkat soal tujuan, pengguna, dan fitur wajib
• Proposal — cakupan, timeline, dan penawaran harga
• Desain — wireframe dan UI di Figma, dengan masukan dari Anda
• Pengembangan — coding dengan preview rutin di link staging
• Review & rilis — revisi, tes di perangkat nyata, lalu go-live
• Dukungan — serah terima, dokumentasi, dan maintenance opsional

en: Yes — Tanto is open to remote engineering roles and freelance projects. He already works remotely with teams in Singapore and France, so different time zones aren't a problem.
id: Ya — Tanto terbuka untuk posisi remote dan project freelance. Ia sudah terbiasa bekerja remote dengan tim di Singapura dan Prancis, jadi perbedaan zona waktu bukan masalah.

en: Tanto is based in {location} ({timezone}) and works remotely with teams worldwide.
id: Tanto berbasis di {location} ({timezone}) dan bekerja remote dengan tim dari berbagai negara.

en: The best way to reach Tanto is email: {email}. He usually replies within a day.
id: Cara terbaik menghubungi Tanto adalah lewat email: {email}. Biasanya dibalas dalam satu hari.

en: There's no downloadable CV on the site yet, but this page covers his full experience, education and skills. You can also email Tanto and he'll send his CV directly.
id: Belum ada CV yang bisa diunduh di website ini, tapi halaman ini sudah memuat pengalaman, pendidikan, dan skill-nya secara lengkap. Anda juga bisa email Tanto untuk meminta CV langsung.

desc.en: Fast, responsive marketing sites — product launches, company profiles, campaigns and small-business pages — designed and built end to end.
desc.id: Website marketing yang cepat dan responsif — peluncuran produk, company profile, kampanye, dan halaman bisnis kecil — dari desain sampai online.

desc.en: Custom web applications and admin dashboards — information systems, accounting, e-learning, GIS and data-driven tools.
desc.id: Aplikasi web dan dashboard admin custom — sistem informasi, akuntansi, e-learning, GIS, dan tool berbasis data.

desc.en: Content-managed corporate sites and CMS features on Grails, Adobe AEM or Sitecore — editor tools, components and integrations.
desc.id: Website korporat berbasis CMS dan fitur CMS di Grails, Adobe AEM, atau Sitecore — tool editor, komponen, dan integrasi.

desc.en: Migrating legacy sites to Next.js, React and Tailwind CSS, or upgrading frameworks (e.g. Bootstrap 3 → 5) without breaking what works.
desc.id: Migrasi website lama ke Next.js, React, dan Tailwind CSS, atau upgrade framework (mis. Bootstrap 3 → 5) tanpa merusak yang sudah berjalan.

desc.en: Wireframes, prototypes and polished UI in Figma, plus design systems that developers can actually build.
desc.id: Wireframe, prototype, dan UI rapi di Figma, plus design system yang benar-benar bisa dibangun developer.

desc.en: Logo and visual identity design — Tanto has done graphic and logo work since 2015 and won a regional logo design competition in 2025.
desc.id: Desain logo dan identitas visual — Tanto mengerjakan desain grafis dan logo sejak 2015 dan memenangkan lomba desain logo daerah di 2025.

desc.en: Bug fixing, performance tuning and new features for existing sites and apps — including back ends on Grails, PHP or Java.
desc.id: Perbaikan bug, optimasi performa, dan fitur baru untuk website atau aplikasi yang sudah ada — termasuk back end Grails, PHP, atau Java.

intro.en: Great — let's put together a quick brief for Tanto. It takes about 30 seconds. (Type "cancel" any time to stop.)
